paragraphs.source_en: Oda Nobunaga had all the windows opened and, stripped to the waist, kept toying with a sword. Lady Nō stood behind Nobunaga, quietly fanning him.

paragraphs.source_en: Miyoshi Sōza was a swordsmith of consummate skill.
